CLARIFICATIONTO ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISCLARIFICATION TOZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement"), made as of the Q) day of fevy, 2019, between 42/9 RESIDENTIAL, LLC ("Residential"), a New York limited liability company having an address c/o The Brodsky Organization, LLC, 400 West 59th Street, New York, New York 10019 and CLINTON 42ND STREET, LLC ("Clinton.," together with Residential, the “Parties"), a New York limited liability company having an address c/o The Brodsky Organization, LLC, 400 West 59th Street, NewYork,NewYork 10019. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Clinton is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street addresses 592-598 Ninth Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Lots 63,64,161,and162 in Block 1033 on the TaxMap ofthe City ofNewYork,County ofNew York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Clinton Land;” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Clinton Buildings;” and the Clinton Land and the Clinton Building being herein collectively called the “Clinton Premises"); WHEREAS, Residential is the owner in fee of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 360 West 43rd Street, New York, New York, designated as Lot 1 (f/k/a Lots 1, 2, 61 and 101) in Block 1033 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the "Residential Building;” and the Residential Land and the Residential Building being herein collectively called the“Residential Premises"); WHEREAS, the Amended Land Use Approvals require that the Combined Zoning Lot be developed in size and arrangement substantially in accordance with the overall dimensions and zoning computations indicated on the Drawings Nos. Z-2, Z-3, Z-4 and Z-6, each dated 9/18/02 and prepared by Schuman, Lichtenstein, Claman, Efron Architects referenced WHEREAS,Clinton, Residential, and 42/43 Realty LLC ("Realty") as the owner in fee of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 350 West 43rd Street, New York, New York, designated as Lot 109 in Block 1033 on the Tax Map (the “Realty Land"), executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of December 23, 2002 and recorded in the Office of the Register for New York County ("Register's Office") on September 30, 2003 as CRFN 2003000401755, and entered into a Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of 00378023.4 KL3 3197427.6
